app.tagline: shared expenses, split fairly, kept in sync.
app.loadError: couldn't reach the backend — check your connection and try again.

demo.title: you're looking at a demo.
demo.body: sample data — edit anything you like, nothing is saved. sign in above to see your own.

home.commonInfo: expenses split between more than one person.
home.singleUserInfo: expenses covering only one person — a 100% split.
home.runwayInfo: an approximate date your savings would run out at your average monthly spend — visible only to you. Set it up on the settings page.
home.empty: no expenses yet — add the first one.
home.allTimeBalanceInfo: your running balance across every expense ever recorded here — ignores every filter and timeframe above.

form.title: add expense
form.notesPlaceholder: anything worth remembering about this expense
form.deleteConfirm: delete this expense? this can't be undone.
form.signInPrompt: sign in from the home page to add an expense.
form.notAllowlisted: your account isn't on the allowlist for this sheet.
form.newCategoryOverheadInfo: essential spending — groceries, rent, utilities, transport. Shown as its own breakdown on the overview page.

trips.title: vacations
trips.deleteConfirm: delete this trip and all its expenses? this can't be undone.
trips.name: destination
trips.errorDateRange: end date must be on or after the start date.

overview.title: overview
overview.fourWallsInfo: categories flagged as overhead — typically the essentials (groceries, rent, utilities, transport) you need to get by. flag a category as overhead when adding it.
overview.discretionaryInfo: everything not flagged as overhead — spending beyond the essentials.
overview.fourWallsAvgByMonthInfo: average per month — total overhead spent (all time) ÷ number of months with at least one expense.
overview.avgByMonthInfo: average per month — total spent ÷ number of months with at least one expense.
overview.avgByYearInfo: average per year — total spent ÷ number of years with at least one expense.
overview.perVacationInfo: total vacation spend ÷ number of trips.
overview.perDayInfo: total vacation spend ÷ total days across all trips.
overview.byUserInfo: each person's share of every expense (based on the split %), not what they actually paid.
overview.commonInfo: expenses split between more than one person.
overview.singleUserInfo: expenses covering only one person — a 100% split.

history.title: activity
history.loadError: couldn't load the activity log — the backend may not have this feature deployed yet.

settings.title: settings
settings.enableRunway: show my runway on the home page
settings.savingsInfo: your current savings/cash buffer — used to estimate your runway. Private, never shown to your partner.
settings.exportInfo: download every expense you've ever added — household, and trips if you check the box below — as a CSV file.
